text: Though nonexistent, they are not to be sought; even a friend is not to be begged; one with scant wealth is not to be asked. The beloved is not to be approached; a livelihood is not to be pursued; what is impure is not to be done; what is difficult is not to be undertaken, even if it is not crooked. One should stand high in adversity; one should follow the path of the great sages. By whom has this vow of the uneven, like a sword, been prescribed?
